name: Runs Produced: the top 10 careers since 1901
title: The ten most career Runs Produced since 1901, beside their Runs + RBI
description: Career Runs Produced (R + RBI − HR), counting seasons from 1901 on, ranked from the left. Beside each player's Runs Produced bar, his Runs with his RBI stacked on top: the stack stands taller by his home runs, each being both a run and an RBI.
